review_data/ruler/fix_test_f_v1.json: My brother is named in a 2025 cheating FIR over money from a travel business that failed. He was never arrested and went to the police station every time they called, giving all his papers. Now the IO says the chargesheet is ready and that under section 190 BNSS he has to be produced in custody with it, so the magistrate will send him to jail. Our neighbour says this is how it always happens. He is the only earning member at home and we are very scared. Does he have to be arrested just because the chargesheet is being filed?

My cousin was caught by the police with some pills in his bag near a bus stand, and they say they are still investigating what the pills are. It has been two full days and they have not taken him to any court. Can they keep him at the station this long without a court order?

Whether an accused who appears before the Sessions Court and surrenders to its jurisdiction, without having been arrested, is 'in custody' so as to maintain an application for bail under Section 439 CrPC.

Whether, in a case under the UAPA investigated by the State police, an order of a Magistrate extending the period of investigation beyond 90 days under Section 43D(2) defeats the accused's right to default bail under Section 167(2) CrPC.

My father was booked last year for cheating and breach of trust after his partnership business broke down, and the other partner says he owes 8 lakhs. He was arrested and has been in jail for three weeks. The Sessions Court has said it will give bail under section 483 BNSS only if he first deposits 4 lakhs for the complainant. We cannot arrange this money and my mother is trying to sell her jewellery. Can bail be made conditional on paying the disputed money?

After a fight over a drain, our neighbour has filed a case saying my father abused him by caste inside the neighbour's own house, with only his family there. Police say that in caste cases no court can give bail before arrest. Is that correct?

I took a 3 lakh loan from a friend and gave him a signed cheque as security. I couldn't repay on the agreed date, so he deposited it and it bounced. Can he file a 138 cheque bounce case when the cheque was only given as security?

A customer gave me a 2 lakh cheque that bounced. My lawyer sent the legal notice and the customer received it on 3 April. My lawyer's clerk filed the 138 complaint on 10 April, thinking the time was over, and the magistrate took cognizance in May. Two years later, the other side now says the whole complaint is invalid because it was filed too early. We have attended every date. Is a complaint filed before the notice period ends valid if cognizance was taken only after it ended?
Whether the statutory demand notice under Section 138 of the NI Act is deemed to be served when it is sent by registered post to the drawer's correct address but returned 'unclaimed'.
Whether, for deciding small or commercial quantity under the NDPS Act, the weight of the entire seized mixture is counted, or only the actual content of the narcotic drug found on chemical analysis.

Police ne hamari car roki aur back seat ke neeche ek bag mila jisme kuch tablets aur powder tha. Car mere dost ki thi, main bas peeche baitha tha, mujhe bag ka kuch pata nahi tha. Kya law mein car mein baithe sab log us bag ke liye zimmedar maane jaate hain?

I borrowed 3 lakhs from a friend for my shop and gave him a signed cheque as security. The shop ran into losses, I couldn't repay on the date we agreed, and the cheque bounced when he deposited it. Now he has also gone to the police and got an FIR registered against me under 420 IPC, saying I cheated him. I paid him interest for many months and I'm ready to repay slowly. Does a bounced cheque and failure to repay a loan, by itself, amount to cheating?

In 2023 my brother forwarded an obscene video in a WhatsApp group. The cyber law charge against him was dropped, but police are still pursuing the obscenity charge under the ordinary penal code for the same forward. Can they do that?

After my in-laws forced me out, I filed a domestic violence case, but the court says it will take at least a year to decide. I have no money for rent or food right now. Can the court give me maintenance before the case is fully decided?

Two years after our wedding, my husband's family started saying my father must give 5 lakhs so they can build a second floor on their house. My father had already given gold and a bike at the wedding. When we refused, they stopped talking to me, took away my phone and last month sent me back to my parents' home. My aunt says money asked for building a house is not dowry because it was asked after the marriage and for the house, not for the marriage. Is a demand like this treated as dowry in law?

Whether a complaint of cruelty under Section 85 BNS by a wife who was forced out of her in-laws' house can be investigated and tried at the town where she now lives with her parents, though no act of cruelty took place there.

My cousin is 20. He was in a relationship for a year with a girl from the next lane who was 17 at the time, and they were physically intimate. She says it was her own choice and she wants to marry him. Her parents found out, filed a complaint, and the police arrested him. Everyone in our family says it cannot be a crime if she agreed and they love each other. Does it matter in law that she agreed?

After a fight in which my cousin got hurt, police searched our joint family house and found an old pistol in a trunk in the store room. They have booked my 70-year-old father for keeping it, but he says he never knew it was there. Is it enough that it was found in his house?

In 2023, a drunk driver drove his SUV onto the footpath at night and killed my brother, who was waiting for a bus. The police test showed he was far over the alcohol limit. The FIR is only under 304A IPC, which our lawyer says carries at most two years. The driver's family is already offering money for a compromise.
